data.name: TableBuilderCode
data.description: Retrieves employee pay rate information based on the specified PayrateId.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves employee pay-rate information for a specified PayrateId from the payroll lookup resource. Agents can use the response to inspect pay-rate data for a company and payroll period.
Use for: Retrieve pay rates, look up PayrateId data, inspect payroll-period values
Not supported: Creating or updating pay rates, employee profile management, payroll execution

meta.q: look up an employee's compensation band in our internal HRIS
